propositions: The inbound absence-probe port has zero live callers after bug 3b5f-1b21-ee14-4bdf removed all consumers (producer, dispatch arm, and router).
SupportsAbsenceProbe protocol and three probe_remote implementations must be deleted along with inbound_probe.py and supporting classifier modules.
Semantic (Serena) and string grep searches both confirm no production code outside the port itself references the deleted units.
The outbound probe leaf (_apply_outbound_probe and (outbound, probe) dispatch arm) is live and must remain untouched.
Orphaned resolved_statuses config keys (JiraConfig.resolved_statuses, reconciler.resolved_statuses) are deferred to a follow-up ticket as a user-visible surface change.
Deletion is pure code removal with no behavior change; deletion detection remains outbound-owned in outbound_differ and binding_walk.
